text:
alana (product): Need a compact rollout checklist for the routing change. Concrete gates + rollback ladder so oncall knows exactly when to pause.

matt (eng): Proposed ramps: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%. Canary 30m, ramps 2h. Fallback variant available (model-v1-fallback).

jordan (sre): SRE thresholds: sustained 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 > baseline by 25% (and p95 > 1.2s) -> automated pause + alert. Rollback ladder: 1) throttle to 10% + fallback, 2) revert slice to stable model after 15m if still bad, 3) kill flag + global rollback.

tara (cs): Add VIP holdback (per-tenant toggle) so top customers stay on old path during first two ramps. CS wants simple UI toggle.

matt (eng): I'll add YAML rollout config to Console with owners per step and auto_rollback=false by default.

alana (product): Good. Jordan add runbook hooks/alerts; Tara prepare VIP list and customer comms; Matt publish playbook. I'll run a 15m dry-run with oncall before go.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled  routing_cutover_q3 start=2024-07-18T16:00Z (canary).
